items.name: adr
items.title: Adr
items.description: Write an Architecture Decision Record from the current discussion or a stated decision: numbers it in sequence under docs/adr/, captures context, the options considered with their trade-offs, the decision, and its consequences, in the adr-writing skill's format and the repo's existing ADR style if one exists. Use when a design choice has just been made in conversation, when a reviewer asks why something was done this way, or when a decision needs to outlive the people who made it.
items.author: Khaled Saeed
